landmarks.accuracy: Photograph-guided approximate exterior geometry; dimensions not surveyed.

records.name: 邵逸夫夫人樓
records.observations: Light grey/white multi-wing concrete building; deep dark horizontal sunshades crossed by narrow vertical fins; paired half-circle top-storey openings; side elevation has pilotis and exposed ground-floor columns.

records.name: 中國文化研究所
records.observations: Low flat-roof white stone/concrete volume; recessed central entrance with dark glazed upper panel; minimal narrow joints and large blank wall surfaces.

records.name: 湯若望宿舍
records.observations: Low long white residence with repeated strongly projecting vertical piers/window bays; dark and red infill visible behind trees. Two foreground cylindrical monuments are landscape objects, not building towers.

records.name: 羅桂祥綜合生物醫學大樓
records.observations: White/grey research slab with very strong narrow horizontal strip glazing on long side and a broad full-height blue curtain wall on front, solid floor bands and open rectangular rooftop frame/louvre screen.

records.name: 鄭棟材樓
records.observations: White rectangular teaching slab above a podium; four main rows of narrow paired windows, expressed vertical concrete fins and long flat parapet; cylindrical stair/end feature.

records.name: 碧秋樓
records.observations: Grey white academic slab, roughly four glazed levels, dark inset glazing, prominent continuous horizontal bands and tall full-height rectangular concrete piers; taller solid end tower.

records.name: 兆龍樓
records.observations: Compact grey four-level slab; deep rectangular facade frame, paired vertical windows, heavy horizontal ledges; exposed rough brown stone end wall; ground floor recessed on columns.

records.name: 五旬節會樓高座
records.observations: Tall pale cream/grey residence tower with dense repetitive small window bays, projecting hoods and facade grilles; low entrance portico supported on square columns.

records.name: 五旬節會樓低座
records.observations: Rectangular pale-grey hostel tower with approximately eight repeated main window rows above podium; each opening has an outward concrete hood; narrow vertical pipes divide the elevation.

records.name: 邵逸夫堂
records.observations: Tall almost blank off-white auditorium wall; very large cantilevered white canopy with triangular/downstand supports; ribbed grey horizontal cladding band at mid-height.

records.name: 逸夫科學大樓
records.observations: Distinctive contemporary multi-wing building: blue reflective glazing with irregular orange, lime green and blue vertical strips; dark charcoal solid end towers and rooftop perforated screens.

records.name: 知行樓
records.observations: White low-rise residence, about four window rows, grey exposed piers; pale yellow horizontal panels and repetitive inset rectangular windows; raised entrance reached by broad ramp/stairs.

records.name: 樂群館 - 梁雄姬樓
records.observations: Low white student centre with solid wide parapet, two-storey open columned glazed front, broad entrance stairs and a prominent cylindrical stair tower at left.

records.name: 誠明館
records.observations: Grey/white rectilinear slab, continuous horizontal window rows, projecting full-height piers; three large box-like top-storey projections with broad dark horizontal slit windows.

records.name: 人文館
records.observations: Low long modernist teaching wing, strong broad white horizontal solid bands separated by dark recessed window strips; tall solid stair/end blocks and external entrance stair.

records.name: 會友樓
records.observations: White mid-rise residence behind trees; exposed full-height piers, repetitive balconies/window grids, narrow orange pitched-tile strips near roof between raised white end walls.

records.name: 錢穆圖書館
records.observations: Symmetric low white library: projecting almost blank upper central box with two small deeply inset square windows; horizontal glazed strips to either side; entrance under broad flat canopy.

records.name: 紫霞樓
records.observations: Tall narrow white hostel wing, side vertical blue-grey glazed strip and projecting ochre/orange horizontal hoods; elevated lowest level with reddish base walls; trees obscure one side.

records.name: 志文樓
records.observations: White/cream courtyard residence, about six repetitive window rows with protruding box air-conditioning units; pale yellow infill panels, reddish base plinth and flat roof.

records.name: 田家炳樓
records.observations: Tall pale-grey rectilinear library annex with horizontal turquoise window ribbons and strong blank vertical strips; tall ground-level podium and small projecting entrance canopy.

records.name: 科學館東座
records.observations: Grey concrete science block with exposed square frame and closely spaced windows; broad rounded arch at service entrance; adjacent wing is open-air horizontal balcony/corridor bands.

records.name: 李卓敏基本醫學大樓
records.observations: Long cream science slab: many horizontal window rows, upper elevation has elongated vertical hanging fins; ground/podium zone has repeated rounded arches and setback driveway.

records.name: 大學圖書館
records.observations: Strong library landmark: chunky overhanging white upper rectangular block, dense thin vertical slit windows/fins, narrow shadowed transition storey and sloping/stepped lower base; stepped top profile.

records.name: 科學館
records.observations: Science Centre monumental front: faceted overhanging polygonal auditorium-like volume with radial underside beams, tall vertical concrete ribs and open dark bays; crest on front panel. Rest of complex is outside frame.

records.name: 蒙民偉樓
records.observations: Tall tower with turquoise strip glazing, an oversized mustard-yellow cylindrical vertical tower on the front, stepped projecting roof terraces and a large angular entrance overhang.

records.name: 方潤華堂
records.observations: Very low flat-roof hall, long broad dusty-rose fascia, narrow high-level continuous dark window ribbon over white walls and small recessed doorway.

records.name: 研究生宿舍第三座
records.observations: Cream/yellow tall residence slab with stacked projecting rectangular balconies and window grids; dark rough stone cladding at vertical end strip and portions of base; flat roof and strong white rails.

records.name: 方樹泉樓
records.observations: Low broad light-grey hall with tall slim window groups framed in salmon pink; central projecting rose entrance canopy and tall blank end tower.

records.name: 文質堂
records.observations: Five/six-row dormitory slab; grey/cream window panels, pastel pink solid strips and baby-blue structural/vertical stair bands; individual projecting air conditioner boxes and flat roof.

records.name: 明華堂
records.observations: Curving residence frontage with grey-white concrete grid and dusty pink brick/infill panels under wide rectangular windows; recessed columned ground walkway.

records.name: 應林堂
records.observations: White exposed rectangular frame with dusty-rose horizontal brick/infill bands, broad dark horizontal windows and red retractable entrance awning over glass entry.

records.name: 何善衡夫人宿舍
records.observations: Long pale cream dormitory slab with repetitive small windows and air conditioners; broad light-blue full-height stair/core strips; salmon-pink base canopy, flat roof and raised ground walkway.

records.name: 華連堂
records.observations: Low residential/teaching slab; cream grey frame around broad rectangular windows with dusty peach brick infill below, shallow horizontal hoods, plain flat roof.

records.name: 崇基學院教職員宿舍S座
records.observations: Small staff residence: white upper wall and projecting bay windows, mustard-yellow lower panels, central patch of irregular brown rubble-stone cladding and simple rectangular windows.

records.name: 牟路思怡圖書館
records.observations: Beige/grey low library slab, very dense square concrete sunshade lattice in two upper window ribbons; recessed glass ground storey and broad white portico.

records.name: 利樹培堂
records.observations: Pale residence with blue-grey vertical stair strips, stacked projecting square-framed bays, small box balconies, repetitive windows and a raised ground floor.

records.name: 李慧珍樓
records.observations: Low white teaching block with closely repeated vertical fins; open corridor balconies with turquoise glass railings, external stair and shallow asymmetric pitched roof.

records.name: 利黃瑤璧樓
records.observations: Tall grey/cream tower with turquoise window grids and staggered projecting side fins. Lower dusty-pink podium has circular/cantilevered blue-glazed staircase and an angled upper wall. Top not visible.

records.name: 崇基學院行政樓
records.observations: Pale grey rounded-end administration slab, turquoise rectangular strip windows, horizontal solid spandrels, exposed roof frame and curved corner glazing.

records.name: 何添樓
records.observations: White/grey academic block with tall solid corner stair tower and small stair windows; recessed horizontal glazed bands, dusty-pink upper strips and lower projecting volumes.

records.name: 崇基學院教職員聯誼會
records.observations: Low club entrance, grey square portal and pale frosted full-height glass panels; thin steel-framed translucent canopy. Most roof and rear are unseen.

records.name: 崇基學院禮拜堂
records.observations: Distinct chapel: long elevated hall with perforated beige masonry screen; tall rough stone-clad curved end around vertical glazing, overhanging shallow folded/sloping roof, external stair and pilotis.

records.name: 許讓成樓
records.observations: Grey teaching tower with long repetitive strip windows behind lower square podium; broad projecting horizontal sunshade/corridor ledges, pale dusty-pink cladding bands and recessed glass entrance.

records.name: 汾陽體育館
records.observations: Boxy gym with mostly blank tall dusty-pink upper hall walls framed in cream beams; prominent cylindrical stair tower made of translucent glass blocks; lower columns and dark glazing.

records.name: 大學保健醫療中心
records.observations: Low two-storey grey health centre: wide upper windows under a continuous heavy flat parapet, side vertical fins, projecting rectangular entrance with square columns, flat roof.

records.name: 大學賓館 (曙光樓)
records.observations: Narrow tall cream/pink residence; small hooded windows with projecting air-conditioning units; deep vertical slit between wings, reddish base and small entry canopy. Top outside crop.

records.name: 雅禮賓館
records.observations: Small two-level guest house, brown-grey concrete frame, deeply inset tall horizontal upper windows and heavy upper ledge; compact portico around warm timber doors; heavily screened by trees.

records.name: 昆棟樓
records.observations: Small six-level cream hostel, narrow tall dark windows with salmon edges, vertical dusty-red inset stair strip and square entry canopy on columns; flat roof with equipment enclosure.

records.name: 芝苑
records.observations: White articulated mid-rise block with repetitive small dark hooded windows, narrow teal stair slot and mostly blank end walls; raised on columns over parking.

records.name: 職工宿舍第二座
records.observations: Compact cream staff slab, alternating long blue-grey window ribbons and white solid bands, thin tan full-height piers; low tan ground level.

records.name: 伯利衡宿舍
records.observations: Broad white residence with mint-green spandrel accents, dense repeating window/balcony rows; two thicker projecting vertical stair strips and flat parapet.

records.name: 曾肇添樓
records.observations: Long low grey teaching slab. Tall narrow vertical glazing/fin ribbon on mid storey, larger framed upper windows, heavy broad parapet; recessed ground floor on columns and a cylindrical roof/stair feature.

records.name: 陳震夏宿舍
records.observations: White ten-storey hostel, confirmed in official text. Photo shows two unequal-height wings, dense dark rectangular window rows with slender external louvres, tall lower open piloti zone, and pronounced external zigzag stair/balcony stack. Small roof/corridor planters and stepped terraces.

records.name: 胡忠多媒體圖書館
records.observations: Distinct low box library with stacked broad chamfered concrete bands; very narrow continuous teal-glass strips between the bands; recessed column-supported ground level.

records.name: 張祝珊師生康樂大樓
records.observations: Amenities hall has large nearly blank wall with two circular portholes, one broad high teal window ribbon and a deep flat overhanging cap. Adjoining lower wing uses regular square windows and pilotis.

records.name: 恒生樓
records.observations: Cream-white residence slab with repeated broad turquoise window groups behind exposed square frame; narrow blank stair/end tower at left and simple flat roof.

records.name: 國際生舍堂一座
records.observations: Official renovation photograph of International House 1 and 2 complex: grey tiled towers with strongly projecting stacked rectangular balconies; alternating green, ochre yellow, orange and dark-blue balcony soffits and window sunshade bands; narrow yellow vertical edge trims and simple metal rails. Image does not uniquely separate block 1 from block 2; use shared facade language, preserve each footprint.

records.name: 聯合苑
records.observations: White staff residence along slope: irregular staggered wings, small dark rectangular windows, edge balconies and shallow reddish-tile pitched roof caps; external entrance stairs.

records.name: 研究生宿舍五座
records.observations: Tall pale-grey postgraduate slab with small repetitive windows, thin green vertical accent at edge and colored horizontal window hoods; solid tall stair wall, ground entry. Top cropped.

records.name: 研究生宿舍六座
records.observations: Tall pale-grey hostel tower, dense square window grid, shallow projecting hoods colored green/ochre and narrow yellow vertical pipe/edge strips; dark ground-level entrance.

records.name: 研究生宿舍四座
records.observations: Pale-grey articulated residence tower, small regular square windows and projecting air-conditioning boxes; thicker slightly protruding central tower with flat parapet.

records.name: 國際生舍堂二座
records.observations: Official renovation photograph of International House 1 and 2 complex: grey tiled towers with strongly projecting stacked rectangular balconies; alternating green, ochre yellow, orange and dark-blue balcony soffits and window sunshade bands; narrow yellow vertical edge trims and simple metal rails. Image does not uniquely separate block 1 from block 2; use shared facade language, preserve each footprint.

records.name: 第十三苑
records.observations: Tall white residence with two slender solid front wings framing a dark vertical recess; dense repeated grey side balconies/window bands, terracotta core strips and raised pilotis base.

records.name: 第十五苑
records.observations: Rectangular cream residential tower, prominent central stack of projecting zigzag/angled balconies, dusty rose spandrels and rough reddish stone-clad full-height end strip.

records.name: 第十二苑
records.observations: Tall white slab with tall narrow solid front piers, dark recessed central gap, terracotta/orange vertical core, stacked side balconies and pilotis at base.

records.name: 第十苑
records.observations: Cream residence tower with white vertical solid end wing, stacked shallow projecting pink/beige balcony/window bands, stepped/recessed middle and flat parapet.

records.name: 第十一苑
records.observations: Cream residential slab with prominent blank side wall and repetitive stacked horizontal window/balcony ledges in dusty pink; center recessed junction, flat roof screen.

records.name: 第十七苑
records.observations: White modern residential tower; turquoise projecting corner bay windows, paired narrow end towers, recessed central stack of balconies, stepped rooftop terraces.

records.name: 第十六苑
records.observations: Pale cream/pink modern tower, repeated turquoise corner bay glazing with small pitched/angled hood caps, broad recessed central balconies and stepped roof crown.

records.name: 馮景禧樓
records.observations: Long pale academic slab with very regular square windows, thin full-height piers, shallow paired hoods and a denser small-window band near top; plain solid parapet.

records.name: 梁銶琚樓
records.observations: Large slightly faceted white-grey academic wing: alternating broad dark window bands and narrow high clerestory rows, expressed vertical frame, flat roof with blocky service tower.

records.name: 第十四苑
records.observations: Tall white residence of same family as 12/13: narrow solid vertical end towers, orange brick-like core inset, repetitive stacked grey side balconies and exposed low pilotis.

records.name: 范克廉樓
records.observations: Low white/cream centre with strong horizontal window ribbons, green narrow fascia strips and deeper pale-yellow spandrels; ground-level covered cafe arcade facing red brick courtyard.

records.name: 富爾敦樓
records.observations: Pale-grey compact block; large repeated window pairs with deep projecting hoods and strong vertical piers; heavy white entry canopy over square columns and broad upper parapet bands.

records.name: 崇基教職員宿舍C座
records.observations: Small aged cream three-storey staff residence, irregular plain rectangular metal windows, exposed pipes and few side balconies; flat grey coping with no ornate roof.

records.name: 教研樓一座
records.observations: Grey/white mid-rise slab; solid narrow end with small square windows, repeated projecting zigzag/rectangular side balconies and thin horizontal bands; ground floor on columns.

records.name: 崇基教職員宿舍B座
records.observations: Small cream two-storey staff quarters with raised parapet coping, simple rectangular multi-pane windows, exposed drain pipes and recessed rear balcony corridor.

records.name: 蒙民偉工程學大樓
records.observations: White engineering tower with broad turquoise strip windows, tall solid service cores flanking dark vertical glass slots; elevated pedestrian bridge connecting at middle storeys, stepped block roof.

records.name: 神學樓
records.observations: Modernist theology slab with very tall blank cream stair/end wall bearing crest, side perforated breeze-block screen, deep horizontal corridor/window bands and entrance at top of slope stairs.

records.name: 崇基教職員宿舍A座
records.observations: Cream two-storey small staff house; dark green metal multi-pane windows, shallow upper concrete balcony on slim column, broad flat cantilevered eave and low simple parapet.

records.name: 何善衡工程學大樓
records.observations: Large multilevel engineering block, light bluish cladding with dark grey/red horizontal bands, tall dark service tower, several irregular rooftop/service projections and elevated sloping pedestrian bridge entering mid building.

records.name: 保安交通中心
records.observations: Very low security centre with pale yellow-white walls, upright slab sign wall and vertical red-brown brick strip; recessed entry under heavy horizontal canopy and flat roof.

records.name: 文林堂
records.observations: White small residence partly hidden by bamboo, with striking dark-charcoal projecting vertical window box on end wall and broad dark rectangular windows; plain flat roof.

records.name: 三苑
records.observations: Long grey residential slab, central tall solid stair wall, continuous stacked green balcony railings and many narrow vertical window bays; plain flat roof, trees obscure base.

records.name: 教研樓二座
records.observations: Compact white modern block with asymmetrical deep blue-grey horizontal window slots, protruding stacked rectangular white portal frame, scattered small square windows and stepped rooftop volumes.

records.name: 逸仙樓
records.observations: Tall grey hostel tower, dense repeated horizontal window/corridor rows inside concrete grid; taller narrow side stair wall with small perforations, green glazed pedestrian link and open upper connecting beam.

records.name: 第二學生宿舍（低座）
records.observations: White narrow hostel slab: almost blank end wall with central line of small windows; long side has repetitive recessed corridor/window bands and dark openings, raised lowest level and glazed skybridge.

records.name: 文瀾堂
records.observations: Warm cream low hall with largely blank facade, minimal small square openings, deep rectilinear recessed glass entrance; pronounced rounded corner ventilator with horizontal louvres near roof.

records.name: 逸夫書院大講堂
records.observations: Low theatre with a tall blank cream auditorium volume and exposed white three-storey rectangular frame beside turquoise stairwell glazing; stepped roof. Red-white-blue bunting is event decoration, exclude from permanent model.

records.name: 國楙樓
records.observations: Tall broad office slab with very dense regular concrete window grid, thin horizontal floor ledges and taller flat parapet; attached low wing shares same grid.

records.name: 衛星遙感地面接收站
records.observations: White spherical radome on a short cylindrical/octagonal grey support above rocky hillside. Model sphere and base, not a normal windowed block.

records.name: 霍英東遙感科學館
records.observations: Long white low research slab bridging hillside, continuous repetitive upper window ribbon and lower stilts; left end supports a large white spherical radome; tall blank end/service wall.

records.name: 上海總會科研技術中心
records.observations: Distinct white research block wrapped by oversized open rectangular concrete beam/column frames, rooftop cube frame, regular square windows and curved ground-level glass-block bay.

records.name: 王福元樓
records.observations: White tiled academic complex with dusty-red horizontal spandrels, narrow repetitive window rows and prominent blue-grey polygonal/cylindrical stair tower; landscaped raised podium and deep portico.

records.name: 信和樓
records.observations: White/grey tiled academic block; continuous horizontal windows with dusty-maroon recess/spandrel strips, rounded pale-blue corner stair tower, square-framed glazed lower levels and broad exterior stairs.

records.name: 陳國本樓
records.observations: White projecting central slab with simple small square grid windows; adjacent wings show dense long ribbons with dusty-red hoods/spandrels, open columns at base and dark upper equipment screen.

records.name: 何添堂
records.observations: Tall cream student residence with dense small projecting square window boxes, shallow concrete hoods and orange/terracotta vertical strips; full-height pale-blue glass stair tower projecting at upper corner.

records.name: 利國偉堂
records.observations: Cream residence tower of same Ho Tim Hall family, repeated projecting square bay-window boxes, orange narrow vertical infill strips, deep horizontal shadow lines and broad flat top parapet.

records.name: 大學行政樓
records.observations: Low grey administration slab, large dark full-width windows divided by heavy rectangular concrete frames; closer vertical fins on one wing, projecting portico with square columns and roof louvre screen.

records.name: 學思樓
records.observations: White/cream hostel slab, repetitive windows with pale yellow/beige infill, strong horizontal ledges and narrow vertical piers; rounded blank central stair projection with small vertical windows.

records.name: 鄭裕彤樓
records.observations: Slender white tower with dense long vertical fins and alternating dark glass slots; broad blue-grey full-height end curtain wall, tall open rectangular roof frame, stepped lower glass podium.

records.name: 潤昌堂
records.observations: Low white hall with two horizontal window ribbons, broad deep overhanging upper wall blocks and simple flat coping; stepped/splayed wall corners and lower protruding white window ledges.

records.name: 李達三樓
records.observations: Academic courtyard complex with long regular horizontal window ribbons and deep overhanging floor slabs; pale white wall towers, full-height glazed entry junction and steep external central stair.

records.name: 李兆基樓
records.observations: Modern grey-green glazed teaching tower with strongly continuous horizontal sunshade bands; oversized rectangular top corner projection; lower glass auditorium with red horizontal screen and enormous sloping white roof on angled column.

records.name: 李達三葉耀珍伉儷樓
records.observations: Modern rectilinear blue-grey glass curtain-wall block with regular slim mullion grid, white side wall, projecting roof signage fins and deeply recessed glazed lower storeys facing stepped water landscape.

records.name: 格林伯格樓
records.observations: Modern residence with terracotta/brown wall panels, slender white horizontal/vertical frame, narrow turquoise glazed strips; heavy pale stone/concrete blank podium and flat service roof.

records.name: 敬文書院
records.observations: Completed aerial photos: angular multi-wing college enclosing broad courtyard, dark charcoal walls and glass framed by very bold white rectangular bands spanning two storeys; tall green-glass end bays, recessed glazed podium and terraces, stepped flat roof with dark grey service level.

records.name: 和聲書院北座
records.observations: Beige residence slab; strongly projecting dark concrete rectangular window frames/hoods in a dense repeated grid, light infill and deep window shadows, pale solid top parapet.

records.name: 伍宜孫書院
records.observations: College composed of two tall earth-brown rectangular towers with huge thick perimeter frame; dense white recessed window-box grids inside, dark blue glazed side slots and connecting green-glass horizontal wing. Heavy brown terraced/pilotis podium above hillside. One official gallery image is section drawing; do not treat as photo.

records.name: 顧鐵華費肇芬伉儷樓
records.observations: Tall beige slab shown from nearly blank gable end: narrow projecting grey vertical stair-window strip, small square top window and stepped top wall; side repeated window frames mostly outside angle.

records.name: 李兆基建築學大樓
records.observations: Small architecture school block: full-width green glass window bands alternating white slab edges; exposed broad brown/grey roof portal with open pergola slats, cantilevered white side box, elevated base.

records.name: 康本國際學術園
records.observations: Modern white teaching tower with dense clear/turquoise glass rectangular grid; low sloping/terraced glazed wing in front with external louvre grid; tall portal frame and crisp stepped roof.

records.name: 伍何曼原樓
records.observations: Academic slab with white facade grid and angled pale-green louvre hoods over turquoise windows; tall vertical blue-glass central strip, sloping overhanging roof canopy and dark stone-clad base.

records.name: 容啟東校長紀念樓
records.observations: Memorial religious building has green metal pyramidal/hipped roof topped by a small cross; polygonal elevated glazed pavilion supported by splayed concrete posts, low connected wing and external hillside stair.

records.name: 龐萬倫學生中心
records.observations: Low multi-wing student centre around open paved courtyard. White rectangular frames, warm tan brick/timber-looking infill, large green/grey curtain-wall panels and slender horizontal sunshades, recessed lower glass storey and external stair; flat roof.

records.name: 晨興書院
records.observations: Shared distant completed-colleges photo: Morningside contains white-framed grey repetitive residence windows with red/terracotta solid end walls, low white public wings and varied heights. Photo also includes S.H.Ho College tall towers; these must not be attributed to Morningside. Existing footprint needed for part identity.

records.name: 香港生物科技研究院
records.observations: Broad institutional block dominated by continuous silver reflective glass curtain wall, white heavy side stair/end walls, ribbed/fin-like parapet crown and lower white entrance podium with steel-framed glass canopy.

records.name: 香港中文大學海洋科學研究中心
records.observations: Low grey-beige marine research block, broad wall panels with sparse varied window sizes, narrow horizontal slot ribbon on side and taller central entry bay; flat projecting covered walkway and stepped service roof.

records.name: 陳震夏館
records.observations: Low student hall with facade almost entirely covered by closely spaced silver horizontal louvre screens; broad glass openings behind, recessed square-column entrance and pale warm-grey podium.

records.name: 何東夫人堂
records.observations: Small symmetric two-level concrete hall, broad rectangular full-height windows in exposed slender concrete frame; central narrow entrance under modest projecting black sign/canopy, wide steps and flat roof.

records.name: 營修樓偏樓
records.observations: Small single-storey white annex on hillside; thick floating flat roof with ochre underside and a continuous narrow clerestory slot; nearly blank lower wall, glazed end corner and external stair.

records.name: 雅群樓
records.observations: Low white lodge with open continuous exterior corridors and solid rail panels, scattered slim horizontal windows; tall blank square stair tower with side notch and visible exterior stairs.

records.name: 禤永明樓
records.observations: Low modern block with large turquoise glass upper curtain wall over dark full-width lower windows; white vertical frame, flat roof with exposed service ducts and equipment screen, small cylindrical stair tower at end.

records.name: 香港中文大學賽馬會研究生宿舍二座
records.observations: Completed Halls 2 and 3 photos: tall cream/charcoal residential slabs, dense dark rectangular windows behind protruding horizontal grey concrete hoods; one side has stacked blue-glass projecting communal boxes with white caps. Open external stair strips and a low podium with vertical ochre/brown fins. Both halls share this vocabulary; exact side orientation needs footprint alignment.

records.name: 香港中文大學賽馬會研究生宿舍三座
records.observations: Completed Halls 2 and 3 photos: tall cream/charcoal residential slabs, dense dark rectangular windows behind protruding horizontal grey concrete hoods; one side has stacked blue-glass projecting communal boxes with white caps. Open external stair strips and a low podium with vertical ochre/brown fins. Both halls share this vocabulary; exact side orientation needs footprint alignment.

records.name: 蘭苑
records.observations: Small lodge partly obscured by trees, pale walls with distinctive irregular multi-tone grey stone end wall; shallow tiled eaves and broad side glazing beneath a low roof.

records.name: 賽馬會研究生宿舍一座
records.observations: Large pale-cream postgraduate residence complex, horizontal repetitive windows and small external AC ledges; curved cylindrical glazed stair core between wings, open pilotis/corridors at lowest levels.

records.name: 九龍中央獅子亭
records.observations: Official aerial photograph locates a small open pavilion on the island/peninsula of Lake Ad Excellentiam, with red columns and green polygonal hipped roof with a small central peak. It is visible at a distance; preserve mapped footprint and do not infer decorative bracket details.

records.name: 眾志堂
records.observations: Grey/white canteen hall with sawtooth/parapet roof profile and triangular concrete fins; projecting upper glass box in dark grey frame, diagonal/splayed supports and open lower cafe area.

records.name: 龔約翰學生中心
records.observations: Completed photos show hillside student complex: tall narrow grey perforated breeze-block stair wall beside white-framed blue glazed front; open connecting stairs and bridges. Low adjoining flat-roof wing has rooftop solar panels. Leung Fung Yee Building and Kunkle Student Centre are parts of this complex, exact facade assignment requires matching their footprints.

records.name: 梁鳳儀樓
records.observations: Completed photos show hillside student complex: tall narrow grey perforated breeze-block stair wall beside white-framed blue glazed front; open connecting stairs and bridges. Low adjoining flat-roof wing has rooftop solar panels. Leung Fung Yee Building and Kunkle Student Centre are parts of this complex, exact facade assignment requires matching their footprints.

records.name: 梅雲堂
records.observations: Completed Mei Yun Tang photographs show several stepped white blocks following hillside, very dense tall narrow slit windows separated by projecting white vertical fins; wide irregular-spaced deep ground-floor columns, rooftop small solar/service elements. Tall older concrete water tower is adjacent and is not the hostel.

records.name: 綜合科研實驗大樓（第2座）
records.observations: Official design render: tall research slab wrapped by massive white rectangular outer frame, dense grey glass ribbons behind horizontal external louvres; mustard ochre low podium, two-storey dark recessed base and open top frame. Not an as-built photo.

records.name: 蔡繼有宿舍
records.observations: Completed aerial view: new Choi Kai Yau Residence is a low/mid-rise three-wing courtyard cluster, bright white square concrete facade grid with dark inset windows, open courtyard corridors and perforated screen walls; planted/terraced flat roof. Adjacent long teaching slab and older water tower are separate buildings.

records.name: 教學科研綜合大樓
records.observations: Official design views: multi-wing block with smoothly rounded outer corners and continuous white horizontal floor bands over dark glazing; striking two-storey open base carried on repeated slanting V-shaped columns, planted stepped rear podium and green terraces. Location plan confirms Area 39 road position.

records.name: 東翼
records.observations: Rounded glass museum facade, full-height curved curtain-wall grid with green/grey mullions, amber inner panels and an exposed flat curved roofline; plain grey side wall.

records.name: 西翼
records.observations: Museum courtyard shows white walls with open upper corridor/solid balcony rail, slim dark vertical supports, sparse glazing and white pitched triangular roof volumes. Street side not shown.

records.name: 羅桂祥閣
records.observations: New museum pavilion: monumental almost windowless exposed warm-grey concrete upper box cantilevered far over a deeply recessed full-height glass lower storey; thin horizontal panel joints, crisp flat roof and projecting/splayed concrete side walls. Interior images establish tall inclined window mullions but not unseen exterior.
